name: PluggedInMCPProxy
description: A VCP plugin that acts as a proxy to a PluggedInMCP server, allowing calls to any of its managed tools.
author: Jules

PLUGGEDIN_API_KEY.description: The API key for the PluggedInMCP service.

PLUGGEDIN_API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL for the PluggedInMCP API.

invocationCommands.description:
Proxies a tool call to a downstream MCP tool managed by the PluggedInMCP server. The arguments to this plugin are 'tool_to_call' and 'tool_arguments'.

- `tool_to_call` (string, required): The exact name of the tool you want to execute through the proxy (e.g., 'get_tools', 'github__create_issue').
- `tool_arguments` (object, required): An object containing the arguments for the target tool.

Example: To call the 'github__create_issue' tool:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」PluggedInMCPProxy「末」,
tool_to_call:「始」github__create_issue「末」,
tool_arguments:「始」{"repository":"user/repo","title":"New Issue","body":"Issue body"}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」PluggedInMCPProxy「末」,
tool_to_call:「始」get_tools「末」,
tool_arguments:「始」{}「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
